Definition: from G4456; stupidity or callousness:--blindness, hardness.
BiblicalUsage: Porosis is the hardness itself, the blindness that settles on a heart. Jesus is grieved at the hardness of the Pharisees' hearts as he heals on the Sabbath. Paul says blindness in part has happened to Israel until the fullness of the Gentiles comes in, and Ephesians traces the same blindness to hearts that have lost feeling.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that hardness is both judgment and warning: judgment on those who refuse the light, and warning to me not to refuse it. The remedy is the same in every case, a heart opened by grace.
